## ✨ Added

- **A group can move to a new phrase and keep its members.** `Group.HandNewPhrase` hands a new phrase to an approved instance, sealed for that instance alone with a one-off X25519 exchange and the phrase the group runs on, so a device that holds only the old keys, or watches the traffic, learns nothing. The other end takes it through `Config.OnNewPhrase`, once whoever the sender knows to be taken out is out there too and the group takes nobody new on the old phrase. `Group.NewPhrase` fills in those removals. Together with `Config.Previous` an app moves its whole pairing to a new phrase, as KnightLoader does when an account that could show the phrase is blocked.

**Adopting apps:** nothing changes for an app that does not use it. An app that changes its pairing phrase opens the group on the new secret with the old one as `Previous`, keeps the old group open beside it with `TakeNoNew`, and calls `HandNewPhrase` for each instance that has not followed yet.
